# ComplianceFinding

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

One reported accessibility/compliance issue, resolved to an element when applicable.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Properties

- [`clause`](#clause): Spec clause citation, e.g. `"ISO 14289-1:2014 §7.3"`.
- [`code`](#code): Stable rule identifier, e.g. `"figure-missing-alt"`.
- [`fixHint`](#fixhint): How to fix it, phrased as an authoring action.
- [`message`](#message): Human-readable, author-facing description of the problem.
- [`nodeId`](#nodeid): The snapshot node this finding is anchored to; omitted for document-level findings.
- [`page`](#page): 0-based page index of the element's first rectangle, for navigation.
- [`role`](#role): The element's resolved role, when node-scoped.
- [`severity`](#severity): How serious the finding is; see `ComplianceSeverity`.
- [`standard`](#standard): The standard the rule derives from.
